{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.34

|gr1= Ropes and Sling Loading

|descr=Returns the owner of the first rope - the transport to which other entities are attached with [[ropes]]. This command is the opposite of [[ropeAttachedObjects]]. To return all owners see [[ropesAttachedTo]].<br><br>
[[File:ropeAttachedTo.jpg|400px]]

|s1= [[ropeAttachedTo]] cargo

|p1= cargo: [[Object]] - entity attached to the end of the first rope

|r1= [[Object]] - a transport from which the first rope originates, the rope owner

|x1= <sqf>_heli = ropeAttachedTo veh1;</sqf>
